recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, sepia-toned portrait of a musician seated with an acoustic guitar, characterized by a sharp, high-contrast silhouette shadow cast against a light background and organic, ink-like hand-lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject to shadow: The hard-edged profile shadow mirrors the subject's posture, creating a secondary visual rhythm.
Warmth to contrast: The monochromatic amber palette is broken by deep black shadows and bright highlights on the shirt.
Organic text to structured image: The loose, handwritten typography contrasts with the geometric lines of the guitar and suspenders.
coreInvariants: High-contrast profile shadow cast on the left wall
Rough, hand-drawn black border framing the composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central seated figure, medium shot, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar neck, creating a strong diagonal line from bottom-center to top-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the diagonal of the guitar neck, moves to the top-left lettering, and finishes at the bottom-right title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper right quadrant and the wall area behind the shadow.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low color saturation, focusing on a single-hue spectrum.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Handwritten script with irregular stroke widths
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' with a detached, circular dot
Lowercase 'k' with a long, sweeping leg

composition.position: Top left and bottom right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style handwritten script used for both artist name and title to maintain a personal, intimate feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, personal tone of the original lettering.
Matches the 'ink' theme and organic texture.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A sepia-toned photograph of a man in his 40s with thinning hair, wearing a white button-down shirt and dark suspenders, sitting and holding an acoustic guitar. A sharp, high-contrast profile shadow of him is cast on the wall to his left. The lighting is warm and golden. Frame the image with a thin, irregular, hand-drawn black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-lettered text in the top-left and bottom-right corners using a dark ink-like color. The lettering should look like casual, slightly messy handwriting with varying stroke weights.

verificationChecks: Is the shadow sharp and clearly defined?
Is the color palette strictly warm/sepia?
Does the border look hand-drawn rather than a perfect rectangle?
Is the typography organic and ink-like?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and title text
The record label logo in the top right
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shadow profile matches the subject's pose.
Verify the border has an irregular, 'sketched' quality.
Confirm text placement avoids overlapping the subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Warm Sepia Portrait] + [Hard Profile Shadow] + [Hand-Drawn Border] + [Ink-Style Handwriting] to create a folk-inspired visual identity.
